name: tmux-pair
description: Spawn writer/reviewer agent pairs (or writer/reviewer/orchestrator triples) in fresh git worktrees, wired up via tmux. Each agent runs in its own pane and talks to its peer through a small Python helper with automatic [FROM: <pane-name>] identity prefixes. Includes a 5-gate workflow (Clarify, Reviewer-Readiness with rules-bootstrap loop, Plan-Check, Implementation Loop, Final-Verify) with mandatory PROJECT.md care for feature and refactor bullets, explicit parallel markers in plans, scoped plugin-agents for the gates (reviewer-readiness-check + rules-bootstrap on Sonnet, gate-2-plan-check on Sonnet, gate-3-verifier on Haiku, gate-3-code-reviewer on Sonnet, RECON via built-in Explore on Haiku), documented engineer subagent strategy for parallel recon/tests/fix branches, shipped rules templates for 7 stacks (Rust, TypeScript, Python, Go, JavaScript, Java, generic), bundled companion skills (gepa for prompt-optimization, dg for adversarial code review), durable standards via claude --append-system-prompt-file + codex AGENTS.md, --effort flag in boot-command, model-aware compact-watcher with /compact [focus] support, and an opt-in --dual-review for a second reviewer (claude + codex cross-checking with Orchestrator-consolidated final report). Default model claude-opus-4-7 (1M context, override per spawn via --claude-model + --claude-effort). Built-in pi support as third coding agent (the users Custom-CLI at ~/.pi/agent/, default cortecs/qwen3-coder-next (EU Pay-per-Use, 256k ctx, coder-spec) with --thinking high; Anthropic-Subscription via pi-claude-bridge weiter via --pi-provider claude-bridge --pi-model claude-opus-4-7; override per Spawn via --pi-provider + --pi-model + --pi-thinking); pi panes run in Writer/Reviewer/Orchestrator roles but skip the compact-watcher because pi has no /compact equivalent.

interface.shortDescription: Spawn tmux writer/reviewer pairs and gated triples
interface.longDescription: Run writer/reviewer or writer/reviewer/orchestrator agent workflows in tmux with fresh git worktrees, review gates, PROJECT.md care, sender identity prefixes, parallel-plan markers, bundled skills, and helper scripts. Defaults stay slim, with standard/greenfield briefing extras available via --with-standards and --greenfield.
defaultPrompt: Start a writer/reviewer pair for this change.
Run a gated triple workflow for this feature.
Use tmux-pair orchestration for this repo.
